Shell commands

aurora-shell's commands, for scripts and your own shortcuts

With Aurora Shell running, aurora-shell COMMAND asks it to do something, which is handy in scripts and for your own shortcuts (Settings → Keyboard → Shortcuts → Add, with the command). Without a command, aurora-shell starts the shell (the session does this).

CommandWhat it does
aurora-shell launcher [spotlight|grid]Open Spotlight search, or Launchpad with grid.
aurora-shell search TEXTOpen Spotlight with TEXT already typed.
aurora-shell dictateStart or stop dictation.
aurora-shell read-aloudRead the selected text aloud.
aurora-shell assistantOpen the Aurora Assistant with the keyboard.
aurora-shell writingWriting Tools for the selected text.
aurora-shell overviewShow all open windows.
aurora-shell osk [show|hide|toggle]Show or hide the on-screen keyboard.
aurora-shell show-desktop
aurora-shell snap-layoutsShow Snap Layouts for the focused window.
aurora-shell always-on-topKeep the focused window above the others, or stop.
aurora-shell snap ZONEPut the focused window in a zone: left, right, left-third, center-third, right-third, top-left … bottom-right.
aurora-shell clipboardClipboard history in Spotlight.
aurora-shell emojiThe emoji picker in Spotlight.
aurora-shell volume up|down|muteChange the volume, with the on-screen indicator.
aurora-shell brightness up|downChange the screen brightness.
aurora-shell screenshot [area|text|pin]Screenshot of the screen or of an area, copy the text in an area, or pin an area to the screen.
aurora-shell record [area] [sound]Start or stop screen recording: the whole screen, or an area you draw; with the computer's sound.
aurora-shell colorpickPick a color from the screen; its hex code is copied.
aurora-shell shortcutsShow every keyboard shortcut.
aurora-shell edit-widgetsEdit the desktop widgets.
aurora-shell keep-awakeTurn Keep Awake on or off.
aurora-shell lock
aurora-shell quick-settings [hide]Open or close the Control Center; hide closes it and the notification center.
aurora-shell logoutLog out.
aurora-shell focusStart or stop a focus session.
aurora-shell minimize APP-IDMinimize an app's windows.
aurora-shell windowsPrint the open windows as JSON, one per line (for scripts and tests).

Example: a shortcut that snaps the window to the right third runs aurora-shell snap right-third.
